name: San-Pédro

queries.query: San Pedro Côte d'Ivoire official cadastral parcel map cadastre geoportal
queries.result: Found the first-party SIGFU urban-land parcel search/map service, the DGI cadastral-site reference, and the AFOR rural geoportal. No San-Pédro parcel geometry was returned from the bounded anonymous AFOR map request.

queries.query: San Pedro Côte d'Ivoire cadastre parcelles carte foncière officielle Géoportail
queries.result: Les sources officielles trouvées sont le SIGFU pour les lotissements/lots/parcelles urbains, la DGI pour le cadastre et la circonscription foncière de San Pedro, et le Géoportail du Foncier Rural de l'AFOR. Le test anonyme de la carte AFOR autour du point WUP n'a renvoyé aucune entité; ce résultat ne prouve pas une absence à l'échelle de la ville.

officialSources.operator: Ministère ivoirien chargé de la construction / SIGFU
officialSources.evidence: First-party public urban-land service describes parcel, lotissement and lot search and says displayed results concern approved lotissements. The service is a registry/map custodian, but its current public JS/API could not be retrieved with verified TLS from this workspace.

officialSources.operator: Direction Générale des Impôts de Côte d'Ivoire
officialSources.evidence: Official document identifies the San Pedro land-registration district and states that each land district has a land book. This is direct local-custodian evidence, not only general national agency prose.
First-party rural-land viewer was reachable. Its current JavaScript configuration exposed https://api.geoportail.afor.ci and anonymous parcel-map routes, allowing a bounded schema/geometry request.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The official SIGFU page was independently discoverable, but direct curl retrieval failed because the host certificate chain was not trusted in this environment. No TLS verification bypass or exception was used.
Current public HTML/configuration was retrieved. The page disclosed the public API base URL and parcel API paths in its JavaScript bundle.
Anonymous filter metadata returned. The exposed rural dataset lists regions/departments/sub-prefectures but no San-Pédro department entry; this is a dataset-scope clue, not proof of urban absence.

Bounded anonymous request around the exact WUP point returned {type: FeatureCollection, features: []}. This is an exact-area/map-extent miss in the AFOR rural service and is not interpreted as citywide absence.
Official PDF content was available through the research web index and directly evidenced the San Pedro land-registration district; it contained no anonymous parcel geometry response.
Official DGI cadastral page was discoverable; it presents tax/cadastre information but no safe anonymous parcel feature schema or geometry was obtained.

fieldMapping.geometry: No parcel feature geometry returned for the bounded San-Pédro AFOR request.
fieldMapping.native identity: Not available: the response had no features and SIGFU could not be inspected past its TLS wall.

sourceIdentity.crs: Not confirmed from a San-Pédro parcel response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: SIGFU covers approved urban lotissements/lots/parcelles; DGI identifies the San Pedro land-registration district; AFOR covers rural land through its public geoportal.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A first-party urban registry/map custodian is evidenced, and a first-party rural API was inspected, but San-Pédro parcel feature coverage and native schema were not verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: The AFOR request was an empty bounded response and SIGFU was blocked by TLS retrieval failure. Neither is evidence of citywide parcel absence.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if later exposed
remainingUncertainty: The local land-registration custodian and official urban parcel service are evidenced, but the public SIGFU API could not be inspected due to an untrusted certificate chain and the accessible AFOR rural API returned no features in the bounded city-center extent. No native parcel ID, CRS, geometry, or citywide coverage was verified.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently inspect the current SIGFU urban viewer/API with normal TLS, determine whether San-Pédro coverage is public, and qualify any native ID plus geometry before adapter admission.
